display: @velexis/ota-sdk contract test (OADR-0016 point 4, ota/sdk/docs/types-and-builds.md §4): tsc --noEmit over the emitted declarations of the SDK and the frozen contract in docs/velexis-sdk/sdk/src/, both reading the generated @velexis/api-types. skipLibCheck is off: a contract type that no longer resolves against the working document must fail, not turn into any. `pnpm --filter @velexis/ota-sdk test:contract` runs it after a declaration build; test/contract/contract.test.js runs it in `test`.
